name: Quick Access
description:
Shows your most recently used folders in the sidebar of every Open and Save dialog and of Files, like Quick Access on Windows. Saving or opening a file moves its folder to the top. Remove an entry to hide that folder, or rename it to pin it as a normal bookmark.

Right-clicking an app in the dock shows a jump list, as on Windows 11: the files or folders you pinned for that app, then its recent ones (Files: recent folders, VS Code: recent projects, other apps: recent files they open).
